uppartners-range-energy:lever:4c3b6a85-0.description: About Range Energy Range Energy builds powered trailers that help electrify heavy-duty trucking without requiring fleets to replace their tractors. We solve real-world problems with real hardware. We move fast, take ownership, and hold a high bar for execution. We value people who are low ego and team-first, calm under pressure, direct and respectful communicators, willing to roll up their sleeves, and focused on solutions, not drama. We operate with high integrity. We do what we say we’ll do, we’re transparent about risks and tradeoffs, and we build trust through consistent follow-through. The work is hands-on. Sometimes messy. Often fast. Always meaningful. Founded in 2021, Range is led by experienced EV operators from Tesla, Zoox, Honda, and other leading OEMs. We are backed by strong investors and focused on building hardware that fleets will actually use. If you like building real things, solving hard problems, and working with low drama, high output teammates, you will fit here. Role Summary As a Sourcing Manager you will play a crucial role in the company by overseeing and implementing strategic sourcing initiatives. This position is responsible for developing and executing sourcing strategies that optimize costs, improve supplier relationships, and ensure the timely availability of high-quality materials and services. The Strategic Sourcing Manager collaborates with cross-functional teams, negotiates contracts, and evaluates supplier performance to drive operational efficiency and support our company's growth.
responsibilities: Own sourcing execution for key components and subsystems (RFQs, supplier selection, quoting, cost tracking)
Identify and evaluate suppliers across mechanical, electrical, and fabricated components
Support contract negotiations (pricing, lead times, basic terms) alongside senior team members
Partner closely with engineering to support NPI builds and design changes
Track supplier performance (cost, quality, delivery) and help resolve issues quickly
Drive cost-down initiatives and support value engineering efforts
Help manage supplier relationships and day-to-day communication
Support program execution by ensuring parts are delivered on time for builds and production
qualifications: At least 5 years of experience in partnership development and/or purchasing in the commercial vehicle or EV hardware product environment
Bachelor’s degree
Strategic sourcing, financial and business opportunity analysis, comfort with legal frameworks and contract negotiation skills (development, supply, licensing, and service agreements)
Excellent communication skills with ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including C-level, engineering, legal, finance, manufacturing, and logistics
Demonstrated ability lead and work in a team environment
Demonstrated ability to identify business process issues and drive process improvement
Deep experience in complex project management
Uncanny ability to execute

Language Requirement: Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English (spoken and written) is required for this position. This requirement exists because a substantial portion of this role involves direct communication with Mandarin-speaking customers/partners/stakeholders. Candidates must be able to conduct meetings, prepare written materials, and provide service in both languages.

Physical Requirements: Ability to work in a shop environment, including standing for extended periods and occasionally lifting up to 50 pounds. Comfortable with occasional bending, kneeling, and climbing as required for infrastructure maintenance. Ability to sustain extended periods of sitting and computer usage
Travel Requirements: Minimal, primarily for supplier visits or industry events
